The phase of a dragging interaction driven over the WebSocket connection.

A drag on a connected client arrives as a stream of events rather than one message, so the
receiving side can animate the movement live and then commit it — or discard it if the host
refuses the move.

- SeeAlso: `WSEvent/Movement`

[View JSON Schema](/schemas/ControlState.schema.json)

Type: `string` — one of:

- `start`
- `control`
- `end`
- `block`
- `cancel`
